lines.text: - 25 are God, or Christ, "on high" with no other M-code joined. Examples are Psa 92:8, Psa 97:9, Heb 1:3 and Luk 24:49 ("power from on high"). They are noted in the CSV so that 13.1 can draw on them if wanted.
- Five are the tree and cedar figures of Eze 31:3, 31:5 and Dan 4:10, 11, 20. The pride in those passages is named in other verses (Eze 31:10; Dan 4:30, 37), and those verses are kept as P.

- Seven data verses are cited in the narrative: Eze 13:18, 1Sa 28:20, Job 25:2, Isa 24:18, Est 5:14, Psa 113:5 and Isa 7:11. Setting them aside here does not touch those citations. Each was cited for another word in the verse.
- the heart proud or haughty: 2Ch 32:25–26; 2Ch 26:16; Eze 28:2, 5, 17; Eze 31:10; Pro 16:5; Pro 18:12; Psa 101:5
- a haughty spirit: Pro 16:18; Ecc 7:8
- haughty eyes and looks: Isa 5:15; 2Ki 19:22 and Isa 37:23 (lifting the eyes against the Holy One)
- the lofty brought low: Isa 10:33; Isa 26:5; Eze 31:14
- "do not become proud, but fear": Rom 11:20
- Rom 12:16, 2Co 10:5 ("every lofty opinion raised against the knowledge of God") and Luk 16:15
- Obd 3–4 and Jer 49:16 (the nest set high)
- Isa 3:16 (the daughters of Zion) and Isa 22:16 (Shebna's tomb on the height). These two have no other M-code.

**One verse shows the other face of the word: 2Ch 17:6.** There, *gābah* is said of Jehoshaphat: "his heart was courageous [lifted up] in the ways of the Lord". The same word that names the proud heart elsewhere names a heart lifted up toward God. This is a change of character (#1919), and it is kept as P with that note.
| M09 humility | Isa 57:15, Jam 1:9, Eze 17:24, Eze 21:26, Job 5:11, Ecc 5:8 |
| M12 righteousness | Psa 10:5, Isa 5:16, Job 36:7, Ecc 5:8, Psa 71:19, Heb 7:26 |
| M53 dishonour | Eze 17:24, Eze 21:26, Isa 37:24, 2Ki 19:23 (the boast that mocked the Lord) |
| M23 strength | Jer 51:53, Isa 40:26, Eph 3:18 |
| M22 praise | Isa 52:13, Job 5:11, Deu 26:19 |
| M41 being heard | Isa 58:4, Deu 28:1 |
| M47 inner seat | Isa 57:15, 1Sa 16:7 (not the height of his stature; the Lord looks on the heart) |
| M51 love | Rom 8:39, Eph 3:18 |
Two of these bear on Jesus, and so on 13.1 (#2148): Isa 52:13 (the servant "high and lifted up") and Heb 7:26 (a high priest "exalted above the heavens").

- **Eze 19:11** was marked forward to M08 in the M72 group B triage. It reads as **data**: the vine "towered aloft among the thick boughs". The verse names no pride and no other act. The fall comes in 19:12, which has no M08 word.

- **The overview's surface pointer** (§3B, 39 hits with a pride-like surface) was a surface match only. The reading gives 42 pride-sense verses. Some surfaces such as "exalted" turned out to be God's or another's raising, so they are S or D (Isa 5:16, Isa 52:13, 2Ch 7:21, Act 13:17). Some plain surfaces such as "high" carry pride (Pro 17:19 "makes his door high", Psa 75:5, Isa 22:16).
